description: Get the current authenticated Coinbase user profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object (id, name, username, email, country, native_currency, created_at).

description: List all crypto and fiat accounts (wallets) for the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of account objects (id, name, primary, type, currency, balance, native_balance, timestamps).

description: Get a single account by its id.

account_id.description: The unique id of the account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the account object; on failure (account not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the spot price for a currency pair (e.g. BTC-USD).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a price object (base, currency, amount); on failure (pair not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a buy of the given crypto amount on an account, updating its balance and recording a transaction.

account_id.description: The unique id of the account to buy on.

amount.description: The quantity of the account's currency to buy, as a decimal string.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the buy result (amount, total, unit_price, transaction_id, etc.); on failure (account/price missing or invalid amount), output contains an error message.

description: Create a sell of the given crypto amount on an account, updating its balance and recording a transaction.

account_id.description: The unique id of the account to sell on.

amount.description: The quantity of the account's currency to sell, as a decimal string.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the sell result; on failure (account/price missing, invalid amount, or insufficient balance), output contains an error message.

description: List transactions for an account, most recent first.

account_id.description: The unique id of the account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of transaction objects; on failure (account not found), output contains an error message.
